name: Ga Nha Trang
kicker: The station front in the centre
summary: Centre rail station: arrive from Sài Gòn in 7 hours 16 minutes to 8 hours 43 minutes for the beach city. Nha Trang is km 411 from Sài Gòn and km 1315 from Hà Nội. Southbound from Hà Nội the five trains take 24 hours 57 minutes to 28 hours 3 minutes.
getThere: In the centre. Walk or ride out to Trần Phú from the doors.
heroCaption: The station front, with the Ga Nha Trang letters over the doors
body: Ga Nha Trang is the station in the centre, the rail door to the beach. It stands at km 1315 from Hà Nội and km 411 from Sài Gòn. Southbound trains are SE7, SE5, SE9, SE3, and SE1.

Southbound from Hà Nội takes 24 hours 57 minutes to 28 hours 3 minutes. Southbound from Đà Nẵng takes 9 hours 13 minutes to 11 hours. Northbound to Đà Nẵng takes 9 hours 30 minutes to 11 hours 1 minute. Southbound to Sài Gòn takes 7 hours 48 minutes to 10 hours 23 minutes. Northbound from Sài Gòn takes 7 hours 16 minutes to 8 hours 43 minutes.

gettingThere: The station is in the centre. From Sài Gòn or Đà Nẵng, use the spans above. Each span is the range across the trains. Read the time for the train you book.

legs.heading: From the beach
